items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026. Period is 'nach dem Briefdatum' (after the letter date), so per the counting rule analogous to §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the letter itself is not counted; counting starts on 21.11.2026 (Saturday). The letter explicitly defines 'Werktage' as Monday through Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays (none of which fall in the relevant window in NW).
